variant_summary: Strong trust model and coherent released app, but first-time visitors must decode internal labels and enter a dense workspace without a plain-language product explanation or visible first-value path.

Added a clear Field Systems landing page, direct room entry, explicit agent and person roles, honest evidence-state teaching, action-led navigation, and a tested no-mutation transition. Brand gate: pass. Residual P1s: mobile chrome hides the workspace above the fold, and one guide completion state overclaims review.

Compressed mobile room chrome, added an accessible four-step disclosure and a task-targeting next action, corrected guide semantics so proposals and briefs cannot prove human review, repaired dark-panel contrast, and passed the full independent QA matrix. Brand gate: pass. Evidence gate: ready.
